crossRefs.note: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t…
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…
He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

translations.web: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.
translations.bsb: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.
translations.kjv: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
translations.asv: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
